import numpy as np
def comps_of(a):
    lab,n=ndimage.label(a); out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
        sub=a[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]
        sub=sub[np.any(sub,axis=1)][:,np.any(sub,axis=0)]
        out.append(sub)
    return out
def norm(g):
    for t in [g, np.rot90(g,1),np.rot90(g,2),np.rot90(g,3),np.fliplr(g),np.flipud(g),np.fliplr(np.rot90(g,1)),np.fliplr(np.rot90(g,3))]:
        key=t.tobytes()
    # canonical: min over transforms of bytes
    ts=[g,np.rot90(g,1),np.rot90(g,2),np.rot90(g,3),np.fliplr(g),np.flipud(g),np.rot90(np.fliplr(g)),np.rot90(np.flipud(g))]
    return min(t.tobytes() for t in ts), ts
